questions.question: The mean of five numbers is 30. If one number is excluded, their mean becomes 28. The excluded number is:
The algebraic sum of deviations of a set of n observations from their mean is always:
questions.explanation: Σ(xi - mean) = Σxi - Σmean = n(mean) - n(mean) = 0.

How many classes are needed for data with range 98 if the class size is 10?
questions.explanation: 98 / 10 = 9.8, so 10 classes are needed to cover all values.
